g.text: Counts are for the 13 moves of the worked example after wait removal. At this size the difference is cosmetic; the paper's benchmarks go up to 900 agents, where it is not.

g.text: The type-2 rule c.s = a.g means a target only ever needs the moves that leave its own goal vertex. Group the moves by start vertex once (CP); sort each group by time
